declaration_note: Cycle-1 review found two gaps in the cycle-1 outcome set. This file declares the additional outcomes that close them, and is committed in its own commit before the probe was extended or re-run. outcomes.declared.json is left byte-identical — the cycle-1 bar is not rewritten after the fact; it is added to, in a separately dated record.

why_these_outcomes_exist.HIGH-1: The cycle-1 prose prescribed a wrapper carrying only `container-type: inline-size`, while the exemplar actually MEASURED the complete :host declaration set. Those are different rules and they do not behave the same. A third static variant, B-abbrev, is added so the difference is pinned by the outcome table #309/#310 inherit, rather than by prose. The discriminating layout is a flex parent, where size containment on a wrapper with no width makes the component's content contribute zero to intrinsic sizing.
why_these_outcomes_exist.MEDIUM-2: The cycle-1 states were 800/900/1000/1200 only, so the sheet's UNCONDITIONAL `@container (max-width: 720px)` rule was never exercised on either side. A generator that mishandled a sheet's non-host-dependent container rules would have passed the cycle-1 table.

static_exemplar_variants_added.B-abbrev: The wrapper as the cycle-1 PROSE prescribed it: `.sk-app-shell-host { container-type: inline-size }` and nothing else. Measured alongside B-wrapper (the complete :host set) to record which one the 14/14 result actually belongs to.

pass_bar: Unchanged from cycle 1 and now applied to the combined set: a construct kind earns generated-static-form only if SOME static exemplar variant reproduces EVERY declared outcome in BOTH files, in both engines.
